svg.title: Conventional and Fracture-Enhanced Downhole Heat Exchange
svg.desc: Left: conventional downhole exchange. Right: fractured single-well exchange. Key: 自来水 = mains water; 加热后的热水 = heated water; 地热水 = geothermal water; 凉水 = cool water; 保温真空管 = vacuum-insulated pipe; 压裂产生裂隙 = stimulation-created fractures; 高温岩石热裂隙 = fractures in hot rock; 封闭环 = sealing ring. Source marks a 200 m interval and claims tenfold efficiency, 80% lower operating cost, winter heating and no government well management. These are unverified source claims, not guarantees or current regulatory advice.
